funding: $155M seed (May 2025; ARCH, Deerfield, Bezos Expeditions, Tao Capital, Rsquared, Earth Foundry, In-Q-Tel); imec investment amount undisclosed.

recent_activity.event: Spin-out from Twist with $155M seed; CEO Varun Mehta, CTO Bill Banyai
Atlas Eon 100 DNA storage service announced (shown at AMIA 2025)

As AtlasBase: Thalia chip, Early Access for molecular storage and compute; CEO Jeff Treuhaft (appointed Mar 2026 per article)

relationship_to_vnx.PROVIDER: Possible synthesis-as-a-service provider if Atlas sells raw writing capacity (not announced).
